description: This header file defines the StateTransitionHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class manages state transition requests, including singleton instantiation, initialization, termination, and request addition. It enforces delete on copy constructor to maintain singleton property.

classes.name: StateTransitionHandler
classes.description: Handles state transition requests within the plugin, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: StateTransitionHandler(const StateTransitionHandler& obj) = delete
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor to enforce singleton pattern.

methods.name: static StateTransitionHandler* getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the handler.

methods.name: bool initialize()
methods.description: Initializes the handler, setting up necessary components.

methods.name: void terminate()
methods.description: Shuts down the handler, releasing resources.

methods.name: void addRequest(StateTransitionRequest& request)
methods.description: Adds a new state transition request to the handler.
